messages.content: Sunday lunch is confirmed to end at noon, so we reserved the 3:35 p.m. return. The Friday flight is reserved too. I need to finish the hotel now for October 16-18. Can you compare the Grandview option near my relatives with the less expensive downtown hotel, including all taxes and the transportation we'd actually need?

Yes. I’ll compare both for one room and two adults over two nights, then verify current availability and cancellation terms. Will your relatives be able to handle the airport rides as well as the family visits if you stay in Grandview?

They can pick us up Friday and take us to the airport Sunday. They can also drive us to lunch and the other family plans from the Grandview hotel. They would not want to keep going downtown, so we would use rideshares there.

The Grandview Heights option, Hyatt Place Columbus/OSU, currently has a standard king room at $189 per night. Two nights are $378.00, taxes are $64.26, and there is no separate destination fee, making the lodging total $442.26. Parking is complimentary, though you will not need it. With your relatives providing all planned rides, the local transportation estimate is $0.00, so the combined hotel and local travel total remains $442.26.
And downtown? The room rate I saw was around $155.

The downtown option, Holiday Inn Columbus Downtown Capitol Square, has a king room at $154 per night. The base is $308.00, taxes are $52.36, and a $44.00 property fee applies across the stay, for a hotel total of $404.36. Self-parking would be $38 nightly but is excluded because you are not renting a car. Estimated rideshares are $58 for the airport trips and $96 for six trips between the hotel and the family schedule. That puts hotel plus local transportation at approximately $558.36.
So the cheaper room costs about $116 more overall. Please check whether both rooms are actually available and tell me exactly when each can be canceled.

Both king rooms are available for Friday, October 16 through Sunday, October 18. The Hyatt Place rate can be canceled without charge through 11:59 p.m. local time on Wednesday, October 14; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. The Holiday Inn rate can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. local time on Thursday, October 15; a later cancellation is charged one night plus tax. Neither rate requires advance payment.
Is the Hyatt total really complete? I don’t want a parking charge or another hotel fee appearing at checkout.

Confirmed. The $442.26 Hyatt total includes the room charges and all currently disclosed state and local taxes. There is no resort or destination fee. Complimentary parking is listed for registered guests, but no parking charge will be attached when you arrive without a vehicle. Incidentals would be the only possible additional charges.
That works better for the schedule. Before booking, restate the full Columbus total now that the flights are reserved.

The two round-trip flight reservations total $646.00. Hyatt Place lodging is $442.26, and planned local transportation is $0.00 because your relatives are covering the rides. The complete expected Columbus trip total is therefore $1,088.26, excluding meals and personal incidentals.
Book the Hyatt Place king room for the two of us. Use the card ending in 1842 that is already on file.

I’m ready to submit the reservation for October 16-18 at $442.26 total, charged at the hotel to the card ending in 1842. The cancellation deadline is Wednesday, October 14 at 11:59 p.m. Columbus time. Shall I finalize it?

Booked. Hyatt Place Columbus/OSU is confirmed for Friday, October 16 through Sunday, October 18 for two adults in one king room. The total is $442.26, due at the property on the card ending in 1842. Confirmation number: HYP-610284. Cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. local time on Wednesday, October 14; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. With the reserved flights and family rides, the expected trip total is $1,088.26, excluding meals and incidentals.
